market.summary: The Nifty slipped 0.2% and the Sensex 0.5% as Brent rose above $115 after an attack on a Saudi refinery and IT and oil & gas fell about 2%, but small and mid caps rose and media, consumer durables, autos and pharma gained about 1%. That mix suited these holdings: the hotel, media and consumer names had a firm day. The Fed decides after midnight IST; a hawkish surprise or Brent pushing higher is the main risk for tomorrow's open.

points.text: Close 28 Oct: Sensex -352.64 (-0.48%) at 73,246.03; Nifty -50.90 (-0.22%) at 22,698.85; Midcap +0.4%, Smallcap +0.9%; 2,178 advances vs 1,957 declines.
IT and oil & gas fell about 2% (Infosys, HCL Tech, Reliance, ONGC); autos, consumer durables, media and pharma rose about 1%.
Brent above $115 a barrel after an attack on a Saudi refinery; the rupee closed 11 paise weaker at 95.23 per dollar.
Jio Platforms listed at Rs 1,358, 21.4% above its Rs 1,119 issue price, valuing it at about $131.5 bn.
Provisional flows for 27 Oct: FIIs net bought about Rs 4,240 Cr, DIIs net sold about Rs 1,250 Cr (28 Oct figures not yet seen).

market.watch: Fed decision tonight (IST) and Brent: above ~$117 would weigh on consumer and small-cap names.

THELEELA.summary: No new filing or news today, but the price did the work: Leela rose 2.0% to 605.20, its highest close since entry and back above the 604.51 entry, on a day consumer-facing stocks outperformed. THELEELA.watch: A close above 635.66 (+1R) moves the stop to cost; the 579.15 result-day low is the line under the stop.

TIPSMUSIC.summary: Tips Music jumped 7.1% to 793.90, a new 52-week high, and closed exactly at +1R (793.67), so under the plan the stop now moves up to cost (727.89) and the trade cannot turn into a loss on a closing basis. Reports found no company news behind the move: the media index rose about 1% and Tips outperformed it by about 7 points. The post-result drift is working.

Close Rs 793.90 vs entry Rs 727.89: +1.0R (+9.1%); stop moves to cost Rs 727.89, then trails the 21-day EMA (now about Rs 708).
Q2 FY27 press release: revenue +35% YoY, profit +23% YoY.

TIPSMUSIC.watch: Stop at cost 727.89 on a closing basis; after a 7% one-day jump on no news, some give-back would be normal.

ORIENTELEC.summary: No new filing or news today. The stock was flat at 187.27, right at the 187.44 entry, while consumer durables rose about 1%. The results story is good (revenue +25%, profit more than doubled), but gross margin fell 2.5 points because copper and other metals rose faster than prices, and Brent above $115 keeps that cost worry alive.

points.text: Q2 FY27: revenue Rs 879 Cr (+25.2% YoY), EBITDA +49.7% to Rs 57 Cr, PAT Rs 27 Cr vs Rs 12 Cr; EBITDA margin 6.5% (+106 bps) but gross margin 29% (-2.5 pts).
Copper near $14,500 a tonne, about double early-2024; price hikes recovered 80-100% of the cost rise depending on the product.
Close Rs 187.27 vs entry Rs 187.44: -0.01R; stop Rs 171.27, +1R Rs 203.61.

ORIENTELEC.watch: Hold above the 173.00 result-day low (stop 171.27); copper and crude are the swing factors for margins.
